description: commutative add: operands swapped from (n0, n1) to (n1, n0).
note: KEY CASE, the counterpart to operand_swap_*. add is commutative, so a + b == b + a. Reordering operands is semantically identical and MUST produce an empty diff. The algorithm sorts input signatures for ops on the commutativity whitelist, so this stays silent. This is the must-stay-silent half of the operand-order regression guarantee.
